title: User signup with email verification

requirements.text: The email address is validated and normalized before it is used or compared
Concurrent signups with the same normalized email create exactly one account
The chosen password is checked against a length and blocklist policy (NIST SP 800-63B), not composition rules
The password is stored only as a slow salted hash (Argon2id, bcrypt or scrypt)
The verification link carries a random, expiring, single-use token stored only as a hash
The verification email is delivered through a retried, idempotent send path
Unverified accounts cannot use gated features until the link is confirmed, and confirming marks the account verified once
Resending verification is rate limited and invalidates earlier links

evidence.name: validated-email: addresses are validated and normalized before use and comparison
unique-account: four concurrent signups with the same normalized email create exactly one account
unique-account on PostgreSQL: four concurrent signups with the same normalized email create exactly one row
password-policy: NIST-style default (length in code points, blocklist, no composition rules) and an injected policy
password-storage: default scrypt hasher writes a salted PHC string (N>=2^15, r=8, p=1, 16-byte salt) and verifies in constant time
verification-token: 256-bit random token in the link, stored only as SHA-256, expiring and single-use
verification-token on PostgreSQL: hash-only storage, expiry, single use; the account is verified once
verified-gate: unverified accounts are refused by requireVerified, assertVerified and the HTTP gate until confirmed
verified-gate: four concurrent confirms of one link verify the account exactly once
verified-gate on PostgreSQL: four concurrent confirms of one link, exactly one wins
resend-limits: cooldown and per-window cap on an injected clock, and each resend invalidates earlier links
resend-limits on PostgreSQL: cooldown, window cap, concurrent resends bounded, earlier links revoked
verification-email: one idempotency key per token, retried with the same key; final failure revokes the link and is reported
verification-email on PostgreSQL: failed delivery revokes the stored token and is reported server-side

implementations.notes: Send retries are in-process; queue the email through email-outbox for durability. PGlite concurrency tests run on one connection.

evidence.name: email-address: WHATWG validity vectors and normalization
NIST password policy reports failures in order

implementations.notes: Wraps argon2/bcryptjs; behavior tests run only in examples/cookbook per-language suites, not in tests/

evidence.name: enqueue renders, stores and is idempotent per key

implementations.notes: Delivers the message; building the verification link and token is the app's work

notes: module:email-signup covers the whole flow: normalized unique accounts, scrypt storage, hash-only single-use links, a verified gate and limited resends. The app supplies sessions, sign-in and email transport; queue sends through email-outbox for durable retries.
